definitions: Ellipsis of Santa Catalina Island: an island of Los Angeles County, California, off the coast, one of the Channel Islands.
A twin-engined amphibious aircraft used during the Second World War.

blocks.text: The Catalina is an American reality television television series that aired on The CW. The series debuted on May 29, 2012.

Catalina is a novel written by W. Somerset Maugham and first published by Heinemann in 1948. Set in Spain during the Inquisition, the novel is a satire on the power of the church. It was Maugham's last published novel.
